Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner

Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/92742129521

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55781  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55782  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, June 5, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55783  Recommendation to adopt an Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA

  09-22, State Clearinghouse [SCH] Number 2024030575) for the Skylinks Regional
  Stormwater Capture Project and approving a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting
  Program (MMRP), and

  Approve Site Plan Review (SPR25-019), and adopt the proposed findings and
  conditions of approval thereto, for the site clearance and construction of the
  Skylinks Regional Stormwater Capture Project located within the northeast portion
  of the Skylinks Golf Course at 3559 Clark Avenue in the Park (P) Zoning District.
  The Skylinks Regional Stormwater Capture Project serves to address stormwater
  quality for both the Los Cerritos Channel Watershed and the Alamitos Bay
  Watershed Management Area. The Project will treat both dry- and wet-weather
  runoff by diverting flows from Los Cerritos Channel into a subsurface infiltration
  basin with a capacity of six acre feet. A portion of these flows will be pumped to a
  200,000 gallon vegetative pond where it will be treated though a filter system
  before returning to a channel. The Project will also incorporate walking trails,
  benches, native vegetation, and interpretive signage in the project area. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55797  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-056; and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-026), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow off-site alcohol beverage sales
  (License Type 21 - Off-Sale General) for a proposed small specialty grocer within
  an existing 3,028 square foot commercial tenant space within 500 feet of a zoning
  district allowing residential uses located at 3200 East Pacific Coast Highway Suites
  C and D. This project is being reviewed under the Regional Highway Commercial
  (CHW) Zoning District standards, which was the zoning district in effect at the time
  of project filing. The site was rezoned in October 2024 to the Mixed Use 3A (MU-
  3A) Zoning District as part of the Zone In: City Core Rezoning Efforts. (District 2)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior
to the meeting.
